sample_unit: individuals (18,369 person-samples) in model development; pilot n=50
models_evaluated: Sleep Age Index machine learning pipeline (under-the-mattress sleep sensor data)

links.outcome: Sleep-age model prediction pattern consistency across female and male subgroups
links.effect: Age predictions were largely similar for female and male participants, but patterns in the female group were more consistent.
links.quote: While age predictions were largely similar for female and male participants, the patterns observed in the female group were more consistent.

screen.reason: The study develops and prospectively pilots an ML pipeline using remote sleep monitoring data to estimate dementia risk, comparing model risk tiers with clinician judgment, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
